text: The author employs an alternating first-person point of view, shifting between the perspectives of different members of a space expedition team. This technique allows for a multifaceted exploration of the narrative, contrasting the optimistic and curious mindset of the scientist with the pragmatic and cautious outlook of the engineer. The tone varies accordingly, moving from technical and precise when describing machinery and phenomena to reflective and philosophical when the characters contemplate their existence and place in the universe.
